rules: Species biology is not an input for aggression or war propensity.
Generated culture may influence learned norms only through an actual culture_ref.
Government structure determines who can authorize war and how quickly, not whether a species is warlike.
Military tradition can exist without militarizing every citizen.
Recent defeat, victory, exhaustion, alliance and leadership change may alter current policy from historical norms.
Profiles persist and evolve causally; they do not reroll whenever a crisis occurs.
Unknown doctrine remains uncertain rather than defaulting to Federation/Human behavior.
